title: actor
description: one member of a group: an entry in the charter's children, or the options of @<group>.actor (<engine>) {..} above its define

kind.description: how the backend runs the member; a member in children defaults to goal, one joined by its at line to call

engine.description: the engine a call, block or scoped member runs in; a block runs by its engine's star builtin

restart.description: whether the member's exit restarts it; overrides the charter

intensity.description: restarts allowed before the group gives up; overrides the charter

period.description: milliseconds intensity counts over, under effection; overrides the charter

ask.description: under mailbox pool, the member asks and gets a reply pool <group>.<member>.reply

start_count.description: how many times the member has started, written by the backend
